page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top left, printed page number at top right, gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: opinio, nec decem: {a}De purga-tor.lib.2.ca.9.Bellarminus, improbans ejus sententiam, contendit ex Ecclesia Romana anni-versariis sacris pro defunctis, & ex visionibus, quos-dam, qui centum annos, qui ducentos, etiam qui nongentos ({b}Beda Eccle-siast.hist.get. Anglor.lib.5. cap.12.tot enim effluxerunt ex quo {c}Ibid. cap.13.[?]rem viso cujusdam probatam Beda memorat) illic sunt detenti, tum detineri adhuc, tum ad diem usque iudicii detentum iri.

Quin & alios Sanctos, poena tantummodo dani cruciatos quod in bonis operibus e vita excesserint, idem {d}De purga-tor.lib.2.ca.7.Bellarminus, {e}Beda Eccle-siast.hist.get. Anglor.lib.5. cap.13.pari ratione, arcet a conspectu Dei & a gaudiis regni coelestis usque ad diem judicii. Por-ro, quos e coetu fidelium defunctorum Papi-ste in coelestium Sanctorum choro locant: eos iti-dem Deo, ut purgatorianos, precibus commen-dant. Nam {f}Cap. Apo-stolicam. Ex-tra. de pref-byt. non bap-tizato.Innocentius Tertius, agens de pref-bytero non baptizato, quem mortuum, quia in fan-cta[?] matris ecclesiae fide, & Christi nominis confessione perseveraverat, cœlestis patria gaudium esse adeptum, afferit incunctanter, iubet iuges preces hostiasque Deo pro illo offerri. Quod ulcus animadvertens {g}Comment. in dictum caput.Panormitanus videtur hoc empla-stro curare voluisse, ut presbyter diceretur coele-stis patria gaudium adeptus spe, non re. Verum Bellarminus agnoscit Innocentium de re loquu-tum esse. Alioqui falsò {h}De eccles. triumph. lib. 1. cap. 2.affirmaret eum difertis verbis veritatem adversus hæreticos propugnare, {i}Ibid. cap. 1.qui opinabantur animas Sanctorum usque ad diem iudicii nec videre Deum, nec beatas dici pos-se, nisi in spe. Proinde manifestum est Pontificios gravem injuriam Sanctis facere, qui pro Sanctis orent.
13 Beatam autem Virginem inprimis dedecorat ista quasi labe, quum {k}Catechism. Trident. de oratione: cap. pro quibus orandum fit.salutatione Angelica ad pre-

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. Uncertain readings: "fan-cta" at the line end (marked [?]); the mark "c" beside "Ibid. cap.13." (marked [?]); the mark letters in the margin are small and partly blurred, and the notes on Beda (b, e) are read as "Eccle-siast.hist.get." with some doubt about the exact abbreviation. The long s is rendered as s throughout; "cœlestis" and "hæreticos" keep the printed ligatures as I read them. The paragraph beginning "13 Beatam" continues onto the next page after "pre-". The note k continues in the margin with "orandum fit."
